title: English Practice Quiz 0937
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A memorandum is generally used for ___.
questions.explanation: A memo is a common form of internal business communication.

questions.question: The abbreviation 'FYI' means ___.
questions.explanation: FYI introduces information shared for someone's awareness.

questions.question: A circular is commonly sent to ___.
options: inform a group of people about the same matter
questions.explanation: A circular communicates a common message to multiple recipients.

questions.question: A formal letter's reference line helps identify ___.
questions.explanation: A reference line helps link the letter to a matter or file.

questions.question: The phrase 'with reference to' means ___.
questions.explanation: It introduces the subject or matter being discussed.

questions.question: An acknowledgement letter confirms that ___.
options: a communication or item has been received

questions.question: A formal notice should identify the action required and ___.
questions.explanation: Clear dates help recipients understand when action is needed.

questions.question: A letter marked 'urgent' should be handled ___.
options: promptly according to its importance and procedure
after every routine task regardless of risk
by forwarding it to unknown recipients

questions.question: A copy notation such as 'CC' indicates ___.
options: other recipients who receive a copy

questions.question: A business letter should use a tone that is ___.
questions.explanation: Professional tone supports effective formal communication.
